Read that as the Microware side documenting a variadic call and declining to prototype it, with GCC2 having re-derived a fixed prototype for it - so a GCC2 arity is not corroboration. **Which arity the library actually implements is unmeasured**; pass arguments the way working period code does rather than trusting any header, and see the `system()` note below. |
| `exit`/`_exit` | `exit()` flushes stdio buffers first; `_exit()` doesn't. |
| `wait(int *status)` | Waits for a child to terminate. |
| `setpr(pid, priority)` | Priority 0-255. |
